name: GitHub
description: Give agents repository tools or let people work with an agent from GitHub issues and pull requests.

methods.whenToUse: Connect your GitHub account for durable MCP, shell Git, gh, and repository access.
methods.guidanceMd: Authorize Paperclip, then choose selected repositories in GitHub. You can edit repository access later from GitHub's installation settings.
methods.label: Use this connection as an agent tool
warnings: Shell Git and gh receive this identity for the run and are not constrained by per-tool Ask-first controls.

methods.whenToUse: Use the provider-hosted connection for the quickest setup.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a fine-grained token limited to the repositories agents should use.
methods.label: Personal access token (advanced)
Chat with an agent
methods.whenToUse: Let people in GitHub start and continue work with one Paperclip agent.
methods.guidanceMd: Generate the webhook secret in Paperclip, then create one private GitHub App with active SSL-verified webhooks, Issues and Pull requests read/write permission, and the selectable issue_comment and pull_request_review_comment events. GitHub sends installation and installation_repositories automatically. Install the App only on repositories where people may mention the agent.
